scripts.build: cd packages/web && bun x vite build
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/server && bun x drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/server && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.dev: sh -c "(cd packages/server && bun run dev) & (cd packages/web && bun run dev) & wait"
scripts.test: bun test packages/shared packages/server packages/web packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json
